selection_rule: 0.11.0 candidate = the exact ripr-swarm/main commit selected at the release transaction boundary
selection_ref: origin/main at the transaction boundary only
required_claims: current selected live head is qualified before source integration
exact source/swarm parents are pinned before preflight
the source join preserves both histories
non_claims: the authority reset does not select a floating head
the authority reset does not authorize source integration or publication
the historical hard-cut and candidate-only receipts are retained as audit evidence
supersedes: candidate-only C-to-T construction as the active release path
T-bound denominator lock as the active release authority
reason: After the exact live swarm history is selected and pinned at the transaction boundary, 0.11.0 will include all work reachable from that head; later work remains outside the protected pin.
binding_rule: This checked-in JSON is the active selection-rule/template authority. At W, copy it into the transaction packet, replace null fields in one producer update, validate all exact SHAs and receipts, and never treat origin/main after W as membership input.
pin_update_rule: At W, replace the null transaction fields with one exact SWARM_PARENT, protected candidate tag, and ruleset receipt. Repin only for a release-invalidating exact-candidate or source-preflight failure; main movement alone never repins.

status_transition.active_selection_template: selection rule is active; transaction fields remain null until W and no membership or qualification claim is permitted
status_transition.pinned_exact_head: all transaction fields are present and mutually bound; exact-head qualification and source preflight may begin
status_transition.invalidation: any missing or mismatched binding, or an allowed release-invalidating proof failure, returns to a new reviewed pin transaction

post_pin_branch_policy: After SWARM_PARENT is pinned, no further ripr-swarm/main merge enters 0.11.0 until the ancestry-preserving source release back-sync completes. Branch development may continue, but later merges belong to the next release.

ancestry_policy.source_join_parent_2: the exact selected SWARM_PARENT and its complete reachable history
ancestry_policy.back_sync: preserve source release ancestry in the controlled source-to-swarm merge

pin_recipe.protected_candidate_tag_format: refs/tags/ripr-release-0.11.0-<SWARM_PARENT> (protected candidate tag; local verifier ref remains refs/ripr/release-0.11.0-<SWARM_PARENT>)
pin_recipe.ordered_range_basis: first-parent commits from MERGE_BASE (exclusive) to SWARM_PARENT (inclusive)
pin_recipe.digest_encoding: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the newline-terminated SHA list exactly as emitted by the command
pin_recipe.missing_or_mismatched_binding: fail closed; qualification and source preflight may not proceed
pin_recipe.remote_binding: the pin producer must verify origin resolves to EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm, the active release-transaction-pins tag ruleset matches ripr-release-*, and both update and deletion rules are active before recording the SHA

execution_claim_audit.rule: Do not copy forward the historical no-execution sentence. Re-audit the selected tree and distinguish commands actually executed, evidence emitted, and any RepairReceiptV2 issuance.
